key.gomacraft_utility.ae_quick_craft: AE: take or craft the hovered EMI item
gomacraft_utility.ae_quick_craft.unavail: %s is not in the network and has no pattern
gomacraft_utility.ae_quick_craft.not_an_: %s cannot be moved to your inventory and has no pattern
gomacraft_utility.ae_grid_craft.timeout: Filled the crafting grid, but %s did not appear (the materials stay in the grid)
key.gomacraft_utility.ae_craft_amount: AE: craft the hovered EMI item (choose the amount)
gomacraft_utility.settings.emi_ae_quick_: When Alt + click crafts, start right away without the crafting plan screen (the plan stays if materials are missing).
gomacraft_utility.settings.ae2_search_hi: Entries shown when the search box is empty (EMI search box, compasses). The AE2 terminal always shows one entry and expands on hover.
Entries shown when expanded. The EMI search box and compasses also use it while typing. The AE2 terminal shows one entry even while typing and expands on hover. Scroll for older ones.
Entries kept in the history (favorites not counted). The oldest go first.
gomacraft_utility.settings.title: gomacraft utility settings
gomacraft_utility.settings.feature.resta: Changes apply after restarting the game.
gomacraft_utility.settings.screenshot_sh: Where "Post to Discord" sends a screenshot.
Hold this key while pressing "Post to Discord" to choose the channel.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_english_se: AE2 terminal name search also matches English names.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_search_key: F sends the hovered item's name to the search box (terminal items go to the EMI search).
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_search_his: Shows the search history left of the AE2 terminal search box.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_search_syn: Double-click the AE2 terminal search box to flip EMI search sync for now. While flipped, the search box has a blue outline.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_tooltip_se: Caches AE2 terminal tooltip search ($) results and builds them ahead while the terminal is open, so the first search is light.
gomacraft_utility.feature.naturescompass: Nature's Compass search also matches English and mod names.
gomacraft_utility.feature.compass_search: Shows the search history on Nature's / Explorer's Compass.
gomacraft_utility.feature.explorerscompa: Explorer's Compass search also matches English and mod names.
Translates hard-coded English in RFTools-family and XNet screens.
gomacraft_utility.feature.emi_ae_stock.t: Shows AE network stock counts and "+" for craftable items in EMI.
gomacraft_utility.feature.emi_ae_craft_c: Shows the EMI list on the AE2 crafting plan screen too.
gomacraft_utility.feature.emi_ae_quick_c: Middle-click an EMI item to craft it with an amount. Alt + click works when the "Alt + click" setting is on.
gomacraft_utility.feature.emi_ae_grid_cr: Crafts pattern-less items with the crafting terminal grid (via Alt + click).
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae_stock_query: Asks stock counts of the network your wireless terminal reaches, even with the terminal closed.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ttf_glyph_lock: Prevents races while loading TTF fonts.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_repo_sort_: Caches the values used to sort the AE2 terminal list, so sorting is light.
gomacraft_utility.feature.ae2_repo_updat: Re-sorts the terminal list once per batch of updates.
gomacraft_utility.feature.screenshot_sha: Adds a button to post screenshots to Discord in the chat.
key.gomacraft_utility.ae2_fill_search: Send hovered item to AE2 terminal search
gomacraft_utility.search_history.hint:
Left: search  Right: delete
Middle / Shift+Left: ★
Wheel: older
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.button.hove: Post this screenshot to Discord under your name. Hold %s to choose the channel.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.expired: This screenshot can no longer be posted.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.busy: Another screenshot is still being sent. Try again shortly.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.unavailable: This server does not accept screenshots.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.unreadable: Could not read the screenshot, or it is too large to send.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.acce: The server received the screenshot. It will appear on Discord shortly.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.off: This server does not accept screenshots.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.busy: The server is receiving other screenshots. Try again shortly.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.cool: Wait a little before posting the next screenshot.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.too_: The screenshot is too large to post.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.bad_: The server could not read the screenshot.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.spoo: Too many screenshots are waiting to be posted. Try again later.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.brok: The screenshot was not received completely. Try again.
gomacraft_utility.screenshot.result.erro: The server could not save the screenshot.
key.gomacraft_utility.ae2_copy_emi_searc: Copy EMI search to AE2 terminal search
gomacraft_utility.settings.emi_ae_quick_: Alt + click an EMI item to take it (or craft it if missing); Alt + Shift + click crafts a stack. Crafting pattern-less items with the crafting grid also uses this.
gomacraft_utility.feature.emi_search_his: Shows the search history left of the EMI search box (shared with the AE2 terminal).
